_comment: Verified CompactSeg benchmark from the matched 15-epoch run.

stages.name: Plain baseline
stages.reasoning: CompactSeg trained with the ordinary HDF5 loader and default CPU execution path. This is the fair before number.

stages.name: cpuaccel optimized
stages.reasoning: RAM-resident normalized cache, channels-last tensors, four measured CPU threads, one inter-op thread, and CPU-safe loader settings.

stages.name: bf16 autocast (rejected)
stages.reasoning: Rejected after a real hardware probe: this AVX2 laptop emulates bf16 and makes the workload slower.

stages.name: torch.compile (rejected)
stages.reasoning: Rejected after a steady-state smoke test: generated CPU code was slower than eager oneDNN for this compact model.

diff.optimized_code:
model = UNet(...)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(...)

accel = accelerate(model, optimizer, sample_input=sample_x)
model, optimizer = accel.model, accel.optimizer

for epoch in range(epochs):
    for imgs, masks in loader:
        with accel.autocast():
            logits = model(imgs)
            loss = loss_fn(logits, masks)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
